title: Automated source/locale-change watcher (hash-diff vs. snapshots)
context: Sources and locale references (emergency numbers/protocols) can change after verification, so a watcher re-fetches them, recomputes snapshot hashes, and flags drift for re-verification. A changed emergency number is a safety defect, so this is a monitoring safeguard. It depends on sources-001, locale-001, and the tooling schemas.
objective: Build an automated source/locale-change watcher that hash-diffs against stored snapshots and flags drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-fetches allow-listed sources and locale references (emergency numbers/protocols), recomputes snapshotHash, and flags drift against stored snapshots for re-verification
Runs on a schedule/CI and reports actionable drift findings
Does not auto-edit content; surfaces flags for human re-verification
